::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
SMIC's fourth major mature-node fab of this expansion wave (中芯西青, 100% SMIC-owned), located in Tianjin's Xiqing Development Area.
:::

**Chinese name:** 中芯西青 (Zhōngxīn Xīqīng)

## What does this facility make?

12-inch (300mm) wafers spanning 0.18 micron to 28nm process nodes.

## Why does it matter?

Extends SMIC's mature-node capacity — the segment least affected by advanced-lithography export controls — into a fourth Chinese municipality.

## Project Timeline

- **Aug 2022** — SMIC signs framework agreement to invest $7.5 billion in a new 12-inch fab in Tianjin's Xiqing district, initial registered capital $5 billion
- **Sep 2022** — Construction begins on the Tianjin Xiqing fab
